■Direction

■Direction

Let's see... Normally, I prefer wearing pants.
Clothes that restrict movement do not quite suit me.

Yes, gladly.
Excuse me, could we get some assistance?

I understand now just how tense I truly was.
In such a state, it is only natural for my form to fall apart.

...No, I will find out soon enough anyway.
Shall we go?
Haaaaaaahhhhh!!!!

Trainer, what shall we do?
Quite a bit of time has passed since we began browsing shops—

...! Do you see? This waste-free functional beauty!
It is truly a masterpiece bringing together the peak of technology.

My, that was quite decisive of you.
Are you sure you do not wish to compare it with other bicycles?

There is no better place than this for the finishing touch of our special menu.
Engaging with her cycling hobby should help ease the tension in her shoulders.

As I thought... I felt closer to the ideal.
Reaching the target time is finally becoming realistic...
I will calculate it now, so please wait a moment.

Please look over here. That road bike uses the exact same one.
It carries a distinct presence without getting in the way—the ideal form, so to speak.

If she can relax and find her natural groove,
she should be able to break through her current plateau.

As for your intentions, I caught on midway through.
I apologize for making you go to such trouble for my sake.

Indeed... We need a more fundamental approach.
First is checking my form. The video—

I had no idea it had gotten this late.
I wonder how long it has been since I spent half a day shopping...

There was nothing to worry about anymore.
The current Ikuno Dictus would undoubtedly hit her target time.

This morning's calorie intake... and the allowable limit for this week is—
Calculated. I shall have the warabimochi.

Thanks to you, I believe I can fully
reap the benefits of our "special menu."

While simulated, it will let you experience our speed. The feeling of scenery
rushing past behind you... is something I truly want you to experience.

Aesthetics are certainly worth paying attention to after all.
The appearance of the parts drastically changes the excitement when riding.

What special menu could we possibly do here?
Hmm—

That was just an excuse. I simply wanted her to get a proper refresh.
To keep her from overthinking things, I kept my true motives to myself.
No, rather than words, let me prove it with my run.
Your special menu seems to be quite unique, Trainer.

Maybe being so conscious of it is the problem.
She looks too tense, throwing off her form.

...I see.
In that case, would you keep me company?

...I see.
If that is the case, I shall accompany you.

Ah, that is to say, the gear shift mechanism.
It may look a bit more imposing than what you are used to seeing, however.
...Oh? A bicycle corner?

Then allow me to present some helmets and other gear as well.
There are several products I would highly recommend—

Looking back, my focus was solely fixed on sprinting toward the goal.
Even though taking the straightest, shortest route is not always the only right answer.

When that time came, I wanted her to go on the long bike ride she had been looking forward to.
That was my heartfelt wish.

(Only the exact necessary power is applied!
A form truly close to natural. With this—)

Oho... Small in scale, but quite authentic.
They even carry electronic derailleurs.

Haah, haah... Haah, haah...!
How was... the time?
I came in casual clothes as instructed, but... we are training here?

The bike fits surprisingly well. Leaning forward, I feel like a real racer.
My mind fills with the thrilling image of accelerating faster and faster—

Ikuno Dictus's shoulders seem to be gradually relaxing.
Just one final push should do it...

The summer limited edition items certainly catch the eye.
While I am currently managing my calories, this is quite...

Yes... You already understood back then as well,
didn't you, Trainer?

My elbows are tucked in too tight.
I am trying to stay conscious of it, but... hmm.

I am fine now.
Now, so that I do not forget this lesson—

It would definitely be wonderful if that came true.
And it would be even more fun if Ikuno Dictus were with me.

...Right.
Trainer, what is the time?

Fufu, once you actually ride, mere imagination will no longer satisfy you.
When you find perfect sync with your beloved machine and achieve an ideal ride, there is nothing like it.
A clothing store... What am I supposed to do here?

Upon returning to the academy, we started measuring her time.
Just as expected, Ikuno Dictus's speed had increased.

Having finished the "special menu," we headed on our way back.
Wheeling alongside us a sparkling new bicycle that hadn't been there on the way out.
